source.note: Offline source fixture; no automated TCDB extraction or image copying.

decisions.baseStructure: One complete 825-card Base checklist. Both physical series are flattened into one equal-availability VCS ProductSet.
decisions.canonicalPackFormat: Four VCS cards per pack; 36 packs per box follows original standard wax distribution.
decisions.goldHandling: Gold is one complete 825-card parallel at 1:1 standard-pack odds, with six checklist substitutions.
decisions.blackGoldHandling: One 44-card Black Gold checklist at the standard 1:72 Hobby/Retail pack odds; series-specific ranges are combined.
decisions.rookieNaming: RC is appended to independently rookie-indexed individual cards. Multi-player RC subjects are pending player-by-player confirmation and have no blanket RC suffix.
decisions.teamReconciliation: LastSticker's later-player clubs were reconciled with the offline 1992 Ultra checklist for Series One and spot-checked against individual 1993 Topps listings. Multi-subject and draft-pick teams are explicitly curated. Final on-card team audit remains a release gate.
decisions.excludedRelatedItems: Inaugural Rockies/Marlins factory-only parallels, promotional samples, redeemed prizes, and expired Black Gold winner instruments are not pack-issued card checklists in this VCS draft.
decisions.variationHandling: Russ Swan #96 has its double-printed back text noted on Base. Print-code-only Terry Pendleton #650 is not split into a second completion card.
decisions.releaseSafety: Images, team spot checks, multi-player rookie labels, and pricing require review before release.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Full #1-825 base checklist, Series One #1-396 and Series Two #397-825. One combined VCS checklist.

productSets.name: Gold
productSets.notes: One per standard wax pack. Six numbered checklists are replaced by six player cards.

productSets.name: Black Gold
productSets.notes: One per 72 standard Hobby/Retail packs; #1-22 Series One and #23-44 Series Two.
